**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- No liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-damages or late-payment interest provision exists anywhere in the Agreement (targeted searches for those terms returned no customer-payable hits).
- §11 (p0084) obliges Sparkling only to pay Fee Schedule fees; §17(b) (p0118) gives us an at-will termination right on 90 days' notice with **no** early-termination fee or remaining-contract-value payment.
- §17(c) (p0128) runs in our favour on Garman default (licence converts to perpetual, no further fees, refund of prepaid fees for services not rendered) — beneficial to us and not flagged.
- §19 non-solicitation is mutual and carries no placement/liquidated fee.

This sits at the **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed.
